title: Your First Weekend at DePauw University, Shared as Cards
description: A flexible Friday-to-Sunday sequence for learning DePauw’s shared spaces, campus landmarks, recreation options and nearby Greencastle destinations.

cards.title: Start in the Campus Living Room
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon: find DePauw’s student-activity hub
cards.notes: Begin in the Union, locate Campus Activities in Suite 002, and scan the university events calendar before choosing your evening plans.
cards.short_summary: Use the Union as your first waypoint for student programs and practical campus orientation.
cards.evidence_claim: DePauw Campus Activities is based in Memorial Student Union Suite 002 and directs students to the campus events calendar for engagement opportunities.
cards.access_notes: Student programs vary; consult the linked university calendar for the specific weekend.

cards.title: Walk Through DePauw’s Historic Center
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon: learn the landmark behind the campus image
cards.notes: Approach from Anderson Street, study the arches and mansard roof, and use the exterior as an easy landmark while learning campus paths.
cards.short_summary: Anchor your mental map at the university’s historic, visually distinctive centerpiece.
cards.evidence_claim: DePauw identifies East College as an iconic campus building whose cornerstone was laid in 1870 and describes its Gothic arches, mansard roof and Italianate columns.
cards.access_notes: This stop is planned around the exterior; classroom access may be restricted outside scheduled use.

cards.title: Share a First Campus Dinner
cards.subtitle: Friday evening: learn the main dining routine
cards.notes: Bring your student ID, check the posted service schedule, and use dinner to learn where meal platforms and dietary options are located.
cards.short_summary: Turn the first meal into a practical introduction to DePauw’s primary dining hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Hoover Hall is DePauw’s primary all-you-care-to-eat dining location, and one meal swipe purchases breakfast, lunch, dinner or weekend brunch.
cards.source_title: Meal Plan Swipes and Swipe Alternatives
cards.access_notes: A meal swipe or payment is required. Check the current dining schedule before going.

cards.entity_name: Eugene S. Pulliam Center for Contemporary Media
cards.title: Explore Student Media After Dinner
cards.subtitle: Friday night: see where campus stories are produced
cards.notes: Visit the public areas, find the Media Wall of Fame, and note the homes of WGRE, The DePauw, D3TV and the literary magazine.
cards.short_summary: Meet DePauw’s student-media ecosystem in one building with documented evening access.
cards.evidence_claim: The Pulliam Center houses DePauw student radio, newspaper, television and literary-magazine organizations; its public areas are open 7 a.m.–11 p.m. daily while the university is in session.
cards.source_title: Eugene S. Pulliam Center for Contemporary Media
cards.access_notes: Public areas are currently listed as open until 11 p.m. seven days a week while the university is in session.

cards.title: Add Local Context at the Museum
cards.subtitle: Saturday noon: connect campus life with Putnam County
cards.notes: Arrive during Saturday gallery hours, explore the county exhibits, and use the visit to place Greencastle beyond the campus boundary.
cards.short_summary: Spend an admission-free hour learning the history and material culture surrounding DePauw.
cards.evidence_claim: Putnam County Museum lists Saturday hours of noon–4 p.m., free admission and an all-ages welcome.
cards.access_notes: Open Saturday noon–4 p.m.; holiday changes are possible. The facility is step-free and has accessible parking.

cards.title: Browse the University Bookstore Downtown
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon: cross into Courthouse Square
cards.notes: Walk the shelves, notice the restored downtown setting, and use the stop to orient yourself around Greencastle’s Courthouse Square.
cards.short_summary: See how DePauw’s bookstore links the university with downtown Greencastle.
cards.evidence_claim: Eli’s Books is DePauw University’s bookstore at 6 East Washington Street on Putnam County Courthouse Square.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current bookstore hours before leaving campus; purchases are optional.

cards.title: Follow a Marked Quarry Trail
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon: trade campus paths for gravel trails
cards.notes: Choose a signed trail suited to your time, remain on gravel, stay behind overlook fencing, and carry out everything you bring.
cards.short_summary: Use DePauw’s adjacent nature park for a structured, rules-conscious outdoor break.
cards.evidence_claim: DePauw says its 520-acre Nature Park opens daily and lists 8.4 miles of named trails, including the 1.2-mile Quarry Trail.
cards.access_notes: Open every day. Observe posted closures and rules: stay on gravel trails and behind fencing; no swimming or rock climbing.

cards.entity_name: Judson and Joyce Green Center for the Performing Arts
cards.title: Check the Weekend Performance Board
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening: choose a scheduled campus production
cards.notes: Review the official event listing first, confirm the room and ticket terms, and arrive early enough to find the correct performance space.
cards.short_summary: Make a campus concert or production the cultural centerpiece of Saturday evening when scheduled.
cards.evidence_claim: DePauw identifies the Green Center as a venue for concerts, lectures and theatrical performances and publishes upcoming event information online.
cards.source_title: The Institute of Music — Performances and Productions
cards.access_notes: Attendance depends on the event calendar; verify the date, venue, age guidance and any ticket requirement before attending.

cards.title: Set Up Your Sunday Study Base
cards.subtitle: Sunday morning: learn the main library before classes intensify
cards.notes: Check the day’s hours, locate room reservations and research help, then choose a study spot you can recognize during the semester.
cards.short_summary: Use a quiet Sunday visit to learn DePauw’s principal library services and layout.
cards.evidence_claim: Roy O. West is DePauw’s main library, offering research help, course reserves, interlibrary loan and student room reservations.
cards.access_notes: Hours change by date and academic term; consult the live hours displayed on the library page before visiting.

cards.title: Finish with a Low-Key Workout
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon: learn the student recreation setup
cards.notes: Bring your student ID, confirm facility hours, and use a short workout to identify the equipment and multipurpose spaces you may revisit.
cards.short_summary: Close the weekend by learning DePauw’s principal indoor student-fitness facility.
cards.evidence_claim: The two-story, 16,000-square-foot Welch Fitness Center is inside the Lilly Center and is open to all DePauw students.
cards.access_notes: Student access is documented, but current weekend hours are not stated on the source page; verify hours and entry requirements first.
